entries.sense_en: calm and not easily upset; here, the houses' blank faces show no reaction

synonyms.nuance: Informal; describes people who stay calm in a crisis.
Neutral; calm on the surface, but may still feel nervous inside.
synonyms.example: She stayed composed during the interview.

synonyms.nuance: Shows no emotion at all on the face; can sound cold.

entries.sense_en: standing alone, not joined to the houses next to it

synonyms.nuance: Describes any structure that stands by itself, not only houses.
General; means apart, without saying how much space lies between.
Stresses being far from others, often lonely or remote.

entries.tip_ko: detached house는 단독주택, semi-detached house는 두 집이 벽 하나를 공유하는 집입니다(특히 영국에서 흔한 구분).

entries.sense_en: smelling stale and damp because air has been shut in for a long time

synonyms.nuance: Air feels warm and unmoving; not necessarily damp or smelly.
No longer fresh; used for air, bread, smoke.
Close to musty but more old-fashioned; also means out of date.

entries.sense_en: growing in an untidy, spread-out way, not neatly grouped

synonyms.nuance: Spreads out widely and untidily; often for cities or big plants.
Informal; thin, messy and poor-looking.
Plants have grown too big because no one has cut them back.

entries.sense_en: dark and gloomy in colour or feeling

synonyms.nuance: Dark and also depressing; more everyday.
Dull and joyless, often of weather or routine.
Serious and dignified, for people and ceremonies, not for colour.

entries.tip_ko: 미국식 철자는 somber입니다.

entries.sense_en: to pass through a place where you are attacked or threatened from all sides
entries.sense_ko: (적대적인 무리 사이를) 뚫고 지나가다, 시련을 헤쳐 나가다

synonyms.nuance: To face something dangerous or unpleasant with courage.
To accept punishment or criticism for what you did; not about passing through danger.
synonyms.example: He had to face the music.

entries.tip_ko: gauntlet(gantlet)은 '긴 장갑'의 gauntlet과 철자가 같지만 이 표현에서는 두 줄로 늘어선 사람들 사이를 지나가는 형벌을 뜻합니다.

entries.sense_en: accepting something unwelcome because you cannot change it

synonyms.nuance: Shows you do not want to do it; you may still have a choice.
Unwilling and a little bitter about it.
Gently and without protest, showing a weak or obedient character.

entries.tip_ko: resignedly는 -ed를 '이드'로 발음해 4음절입니다: 리-자이-니드-리.

entries.sense_en: to separate and go in different directions

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and general; can be sudden and complete.
One smaller path leaves the main one.
synonyms.example: A path branches off to the beach.

synonyms.nuance: People separate and go their own ways; often used for friends.

entries.sense_en: a strong call that you feel you must obey

synonyms.nuance: Plain word; no sense of a command.
A direct order from someone with authority.
A gentle, inviting signal.

entries.tip_ko: summons는 단수 명사입니다. 복수는 summonses.

entries.sense_en: not planned or important; said in passing
entries.sense_ko: 지나가듯 한, 가벼운, 별 의미 없는

synonyms.nuance: Brief and not important, as in a passing remark.
Said without thinking; may seem rude or careless.
Not formal; about style or manner, not about importance.

entries.sense_en: unfriendly and opposed; here, a place that does not suit romance

synonyms.nuance: Mild; simply not warm.
Of places or climates hard to live in; also of unwelcoming people.
Actively opposing someone; stronger and more personal.

entries.sense_en: pushed and bumped roughly in a crowd

synonyms.nuance: One hard push, more deliberate and rough.
Push with the elbow to make room.
A single, often accidental knock.

entries.tip_ko: jostle의 t는 소리 나지 않습니다: '자슬'.

entries.sense_en: a long, repeated chant; here, the shop-boys' shouted sales cries

synonyms.nuance: A rhythmic repeated shout or song.
A spoken list, less musical.
A phrase that keeps coming back.

entries.tip_ko: 원래 교회에서 사제와 회중이 번갈아 하는 기도를 뜻합니다.

entries.sense_en: came together into one; the separate noises merged

synonyms.nuance: Join so that the parts become one.
Plain word; just come together.
synonyms.example: The lines meet at a point.

synonyms.nuance: People or things collect in one place.

entries.tip_ko: diverge(갈라지다)의 반대말입니다.

entries.sense_en: a large ceremonial cup, used in church for wine

synonyms.nuance: A drinking glass with a stem; not necessarily religious.
Ordinary word.

entries.sense_en: a large crowd of people pressed together

synonyms.nuance: Everyday, neutral.
Disorderly and possibly violent.
Formal or literary; a very large number.

entries.sense_en: deep love and admiration, almost like worship

synonyms.nuance: Loyal, long-lasting love or commitment.
Religious, or an extreme love treating someone as a god.
Intense but shallow, short-lived passion.

entries.sense_en: to strike or fall on a surface

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for hitting.
Repeated hits, as of rain or waves.
The usual modern sense of impinge on: to intrude on rights or time.

entries.modern: Today impinge usually means 'affect or intrude on' (impinge on someone's rights)

entries.sense_en: completely soaked with water

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; very wet.
So full of water it cannot hold more; soil, boats.
Wet and soft, often unpleasant (food, ground).

entries.sense_en: to cover or hide as if with a thin cloth

synonyms.nuance: General word for hiding.
Cover completely, often in mist or mystery.
Hide a feeling or smell behind something else.

entries.sense_en: a period of quiet time away for prayer and religious study

synonyms.nuance: A short holiday for fun and rest, not religious.
A religious journey to a holy place; a retreat means staying in one quiet place.

entries.tip_ko: 군사 용어 '후퇴'와 같은 단어지만 여기서는 조용히 기도하며 지내는 수련 기간입니다.

entries.sense_en: relaxed and comfortable, in a natural pose

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; not tense.
Feels physically or socially fine.
Feeling as comfortable as in your own house.

entries.sense_en: you are lucky (to be able to go); said with a little envy

synonyms.nuance: Common modern equivalent; can be teasing.
Praise, or sometimes sarcasm; less about envy.

entries.tip_ko: 아일랜드 영어에서 지금도 쓰는 표현으로, 부러움이나 가벼운 비꼼을 담습니다. 미국·영국 표준 영어에서는 드뭅니다.

entries.sense_en: too many to count

synonyms.nuance: Everyday, more common.
Just 'many'; can be counted.
Literary; many and varied.

entries.sense_en: foolish acts or ideas; here, silly daydreams

synonyms.nuance: General quality of being foolish.
Stronger; wildly unwise.
synonyms.example: It would be madness to go.

synonyms.nuance: Ideas that make no sense, not necessarily harmful.

entries.sense_en: to destroy completely; here, to wish the waiting days out of existence

synonyms.nuance: Informal and common; remove completely.
synonyms.example: The flood wiped out the village.

synonyms.nuance: Remove all trace so nothing is visible.
General; may leave parts behind.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 둘째 음절에 옵니다: 어-나이-얼-레이트.

entries.sense_en: boring because slow and long

synonyms.nuance: Everyday, general.
Boring because it never changes.
Literary; tiring as well as dull.

entries.sense_en: felt restless and annoyed at a limit or restriction

synonyms.nuance: Worry and be uneasy.
Show or feel quiet anger.
The literal sense: skin sore from rubbing.

entries.tip_ko: 원래 '쓸려서 아프다'는 뜻에서 '속박에 짜증나다'로 확장됐습니다. chafe against + 제약.

entries.sense_en: enjoyed something deeply and without hurry

synonyms.nuance: Enjoy warmth or attention, as in sunlight or praise.
Sink into a feeling, often a bad one; can be negative.
Enjoy noisily and with great energy.

entries.sense_en: to waste time doing nothing useful

synonyms.nuance: Informal; lazily spend time.
Stop working as hard as you should.
Move or work too slowly.

entries.tip_ko: idol(우상)과 발음이 같습니다.

entries.sense_en: in a short, slightly rude way

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; just short.
Quick and impolite; sounds rough.
Suddenly; about timing more than tone.

entries.sense_en: in a bad mood

synonyms.nuance: Everyday modern phrase.
Slightly unwell or unhappy without a clear cause.
synonyms.example: I feel out of sorts today.

synonyms.nuance: Angry and easily upset.

entries.tip_ko: humour는 영국식 철자, 미국식은 humor. 여기서 '유머'가 아니라 '기분'입니다.

entries.sense_en: filled with doubt or fear; "my heart misgave me" means I felt worried

synonyms.nuance: Plain modern wording.
As in 'my heart sank': sudden disappointment.
Stronger; expects real danger.

entries.modern: "I had a bad feeling" / "my heart sank"
entries.tip_ko: 명사 misgivings(불안, 걱정)로 더 자주 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: talking too much, usually about unimportant things

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; likes to talk.
Friendly and informal.
Uses too many words to explain, in speech or writing.

entries.sense_en: religious; here, for a religious cause

synonyms.nuance: Sincerely and strongly religious; always positive.
General word.
Negative: showing off one's goodness.

entries.tip_ko: pious는 상황에 따라 '위선적으로 독실한 척하는'이라는 부정적 뉘앙스도 가집니다.

entries.sense_en: closing the hand tightly, showing anger or frustration

synonyms.nuance: Hold something firmly.
Press from all sides; can be gentle.
Make firmer; general.

entries.sense_en: to postpone; here, you will have to give up the bazaar for tonight
entries.sense_ko: 미루다, 단념하다 (오늘 밤 바자는 포기해야겠다는 뜻)

synonyms.nuance: More formal; move to a set later time.
Make late, often unwillingly.
Formal; leave to a later time.

entries.tip_ko: put off는 '역겹게 하다'라는 뜻도 있으니 문맥으로 구별하세요.

entries.sense_en: a key for the front door

synonyms.nuance: Modern everyday phrase.
Says exactly which door.

entries.tip_ko: latchkey kid는 부모가 일해서 열쇠를 들고 다니는 아이를 뜻합니다.

entries.sense_en: filled with a large crowd

synonyms.nuance: Everyday, general.
Informal; completely full.
Full of moving people or animals.

entries.sense_en: made quickly from whatever was available; temporary

synonyms.nuance: Temporary substitute of low quality.
Just not permanent.
Formal; arranged for one purpose.

entries.sense_en: falling down; in ruins

synonyms.nuance: Run-down from age and neglect.
Abandoned and decaying.
Breaking apart bit by bit.

entries.tip_ko: 요즘은 '파멸적인, 엄청나게 비싼'(ruinous cost)이라는 뜻으로 더 많이 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: surrounded like a belt

synonyms.nuance: Make a ring around.
Plain word; surround in a circle.
General; on all sides.

entries.sense_en: spreads through every part of a place

synonyms.nuance: Plain word.
Pass slowly into every part, like liquid or smell.
Fill until nothing more can be held.

entries.sense_en: a flat tray, usually of metal, for carrying things

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for a flat carrier.
Large dish for serving food.

entries.sense_en: a small, unimportant lie

synonyms.nuance: A kind lie told to spare feelings.
General; can be serious.
Formal, softer than lie.

entries.sense_en: stayed on, not wanting to leave

synonyms.nuance: Hang around with no clear purpose, sometimes suspiciously.
Move slowly; about walking or working.
Plain word.

entries.tip_ko: linger는 singer(싱어)와 달리 g 소리를 냅니다: 링거.

entries.sense_en: things offered for sale

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; items for sale.
Formal, business use.
Things made to sell, by a company.

entries.tip_ko: wares는 복수형으로 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: laughed at with scorn; here, he feels mocked

synonyms.nuance: Laugh at, often by imitating.
Make someone look foolish.
Feel or show contempt.

entries.sense_en: severe mental pain

synonyms.nuance: Intense pain, physical or mental.
Long, cruel suffering.
Milder; worry or unhappiness.
